title: Vectors: raw RX event CBOR payloads
description: Acceptance: shared test vectors for raw RX
notes: STATUS 2026-08-25 (vector worker): PARTIALLY SHIPPED, LEFT OPEN — encoder surface absent. What shipped: test/vectors/lci_raw_diag.json carries rx_event vectors (rx_event_full_spec_example, rx_event_minimal, rx_status_* siblings) driven through the real client decoder normalize_raw_rx_event / normalize_raw_rx_status (python/src/lichen/client/lci.py:714,694) via consumer python/tests/coap/test_lci_status_side_vectors.py. What is ABSENT and why this stays open: no Python PRODUCER exists for /diag/raw/rx or /diag/raw/rx/events payloads — python/src/lichen/coap/resources/ has no diag module and site.py mounts nothing under /diag/; the event payloads are emitted firmware-side only. The pinned encoded_hex bytes therefore come from the reference-CBOR-codec oracle (cbor2.dumps of the spec-17.5.4-shaped input), not from a running LICHEN encoder; per vector policy the bead stays open until an observable /diag/raw/rx/events resource exists to drive byte-exact producer validation. The TX half of raw diag is closed separately under l1qw.9.8.4.3.5 (real LciClient.send_raw_tx encoder).
